name: PixiBud AI circle artwork, in-place photometric relighting, and RotSprite rotation
description: Verify drawing a circle shape, rendering 2.5D Photometric lighting with in-place overwrite upon azimuth change, applying specular glints, and executing 45° RotSprite rotation.

planSteps.description: Verify the drawing canvas workspace is visible in the center viewport
Select the Ellipse tool from the left toolbar
Click and drag across the center canvas to draw a circle
Click the PixiBud AI tab in the right inspector panel
Verify the 2.5D Photometric Studio section is displayed with an Auto/Manual mode switch
Keep Auto mode selected and click the Analyze & Render button
Verify a dedicated Photometric layer is rendered on the canvas with AI-inferred lighting
Switch to Manual mode and select the Gold / Brass material chip
Change the Direction (azimuth) slider in the Light Direction panel
Click the Render Photometric button again
Verify the photometric lighting updates in-place on the existing layer without creating a duplicate layer
Click the Specular Glint action button
Verify the rotated artwork and lighting remain cleanly rendered without orphan pixels
